content:
mia: rolled Borealis-7B q4-int8 to canary yesterday (us-east-1c) — seeing occasional repetition on short prompts and p99 token latency +200ms. any ideas?

sam: I see the p99 spike on metrics, good catch. dashboard: https://internal.metrics/r/borealis/canary :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lee: can you paste a minimal repro and the quant config?

mia: here's a short repro and a tiny perf snippet:
```prompt
Q: Translate to French: "Hello world"
A:
```
bad output:
```
Bonjour bonjour bonjour
```
perf (short prompts):
```
median: 18ms
p95: 42ms
p99: 260ms
```
quant config:
```
model: borealis-7b
quant: q4_int8
kv_cache: enabled
kernels: auto
```

jordan: KV cache miss rate jumping after a few tokens can cause that repetition if cache fallback reinitializes state. checking routing logs.

nora: I can repro locally with a tiny harness (sending logs now).

eval-bot: automated-eval: openqa suite: +4.1% repetition metric, perplexity +0.8 vs fp16 baseline. full report: https://internal.evals/borealis/18550123

deploy-bot: rollout: canary 5% -> auto-rollback if error_rate>1% or p99>2x baseline.

lee: hypothesis: kernel selection for short sequences picks a less-optimized path with q4 kernels. try forcing alt kernel and retest.

sam: I'll collect perf profile from a canary box: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/perf-collect --model borealis-7b --window 5m` and upload.

mia: short-term mitigation: route latency-sensitive endpoints to borealis-fp16 or to previous model variant. low-risk, quick.

jordan: proposed runbook (quick):
1) pause canary (set rollout=0%)
2) force fallback routing to fp16 for low-latency routes
3) collect KV trace (+kv-eviction logs)
4) run targeted quant sanity eval (short prompt focused)
5) try kernel force/alt quant build and re-canary

nora: quant sanity results: repetition_rate: fp16=0.9% q4=3.6% (+2.7%); p99_delta: +210ms

lee: makes sense. I'll try building a quant kernel variant with fused-attn disabled for short seq and test.

mia: filing bug AI-9832 with repro + logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AI-9832

olivia: product: no customer-facing escalations yet but keep me updated, tagging for visibility @olivia

jordan: scheduling 30m triage huddle in #eng-ml — please join if you're on call. thanks all :thumbsup:
